use_when: durable intent/specification artifacts would reduce drift
an idea/feature requires structured Spec -> Plan -> Tasks -> Implement flow
an existing Spec Kit project benefits from its supported bug or lifecycle workflows
avoid_when: a tiny local change is already clear and verifiable
the project already has an equally trustworthy specification lifecycle
a community extension has not been reviewed for provenance and permissions

notes: PyPI `uv tool install specify-cli` and pinned GitHub release-source installs are both currently supported upstream; prefer the project's/operator's existing package-management policy and pin versions when reproducibility matters.
One-time evaluation can use upstream `uvx --from git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git specify ...` without persistent installation.
Do not run `specify init` automatically in an existing repository until project-specific files, local modifications, and the selected agent integration have been inspected.
Core Spec Kit and community extensions have different trust surfaces; catalog presence is not an endorsement.

permissions: project file writes only when initialization or workflow artifacts are intentionally created

checks: run `specify version` as the local CLI/runtime sanity check
use read-only `specify self check` when current-version status is relevant
confirm the intended AI-agent integration is active after project initialization
exercise one route-relevant workflow on a bounded feature/bug before broader adoption
verify created artifacts reduce the original ambiguity/traceability gap

steps: disable/remove any extension through the upstream CLI before deleting it manually
revert project-level Spec Kit files through version control when they were added only for evaluation
uninstall the `specify-cli` tool using the package manager that installed it when no longer needed

warnings: Spec Kit is itself an extensible development harness; AAOP must not reimplement or silently layer a competing spec workflow on top of it.
Community extensions are independently maintained and require source/provenance/permission review before consequential use.
